projects.title: New Kid in Town
projects.description:
In an already established market of retail supermarkets, this new player decided to venture into the unexplored segment of discount stores, launching 50 shops across the country in one day.

We were selected to create a meaningful, eye-catching and unique brand identity, to stand out among the bigger, established supermarkets.

Despite limitations in colour and style, we were able to produce and launch a brand that become a household name within its first six months of operation.
